'Occupying' means in, upon, getting in, on, out of, or off a vehicle.
'Insured location' refers to the residence premises and any other premises listed in the Declarations.
As used in this policy, 'actual cash value' means replacement cost less depreciation.
'Covered auto' means any vehicle shown in the Declarations, plus newly acquired vehicles reported within 30 days.
The term 'dependent' means your spouse and your children under age 26.
'Pre-existing condition' means any illness or injury for which you received treatment or advice in the 12 months before your coverage began.
What does 'named insured' mean? It's the person or business listed on the declarations page as the policyholder.
'Pollutants' means any solid, liquid, gaseous, or thermal irritant or contaminant, including smoke, vapor, soot, fumes, acids, and chemicals.
In this policy, 'family member' means a person related to you by blood, marriage, or adoption who lives in your household.
'Hospital' means an institution licensed as a hospital that provides 24-hour nursing care under the supervision of physicians.
For purposes of this coverage, 'trip' means travel to a destination more than 100 miles from your home.
'Accident' means a sudden, unexpected, and unintended event that causes injury.
'Business' includes trade, profession, or occupation, whether full-time, part-time, or occasional.
'Medically necessary' means services that are appropriate and consistent with the diagnosis and accepted standards of medical practice.
'Your work' means work or operations performed by you or on your behalf, and materials, parts, or equipment furnished in connection with that work.
The word 'sickness' means an illness or disease that first manifests while the policy is in force.
'Totally disabled' means you are unable to perform the material duties of your own occupation due to injury or sickness.
What counts as a 'collision'? It's the upset of your car or its impact with another vehicle or object.
'Residence premises' means the one-family dwelling where you reside, including the grounds and other structures.
'Insured contract' means a lease of premises, a sidetrack agreement, an easement, or that part of any contract under which you assume tort liability.
'Beneficiary' means the person or persons named by the owner to receive the death benefit.
'Wages' means the money rate at which the service rendered is recompensed under the contract of hiring.
'Specialist' refers to a physician who focuses on a specific area of medicine, such as a cardiologist or dermatologist.
'Property damage' means physical injury to tangible property, including all resulting loss of use, or loss of use of tangible property that is not physically injured.
In plain English, 'replacement cost' is what it would cost to replace your item with a new one of similar kind and quality today.
'Insured' means you, your resident relatives, and anyone else under age 21 in the care of any of these persons.
'Mobile equipment' means land vehicles such as bulldozers, forklifts, and farm machinery designed primarily for use off public roads.
'Cash value' means the amount available to the owner upon surrender of the policy, less any outstanding loans.
The term 'flood' means a general and temporary condition of partial or complete inundation of normally dry land.
'Hazardous activity' includes mountaineering, skydiving, hang gliding, and motor racing.
'Physician' means a licensed medical practitioner other than you or a member of your immediate family.
'Elimination period' means the number of days of disability that must pass before benefits begin.
'Statutory employee' means a worker who is deemed by law to be your employee for workers' compensation purposes.
Under your plan, 'emergency medical condition' means symptoms severe enough that a prudent layperson would expect serious harm without immediate care.
'Vacancy' means the building does not contain enough business personal property to conduct customary operations.
Who is a 'resident relative'? Someone related to you who lives in your home, including a ward or foster child.
'Diagnostic services' means tests ordered by a physician to determine the cause of symptoms, such as X-rays and lab work.
'Policy year' means the 12-month period beginning on the policy date and each anniversary.
'Theft' includes attempted theft and loss of property from a known place when it is likely the property has been stolen.
'Common carrier' means any land, water, or air conveyance operated under a license for the transportation of passengers for hire.
'Loss' means direct and accidental loss of or damage to covered property.
'Impaired property' means tangible property, other than your product or your work, that cannot be used or is less useful because it incorporates your defective product.
'Rental vehicle' means a car leased by you from a licensed rental company for a period of 30 days or less.
The term 'out-of-pocket maximum' refers to the most you will pay in a plan year for covered services before the plan pays 100%.
'Spouse' includes a domestic partner who meets the eligibility requirements set out in the plan.
For this endorsement, 'home business' means a business conducted on the residence premises by an insured.
'Average weekly wage' refers to the employee's earnings averaged over the 13 weeks before the injury.
'Act of terrorism' means any act certified by the Secretary of the Treasury as an act of terrorism under federal law.
'Uninsured motor vehicle' means a vehicle for which no bodily injury liability policy applies at the time of the accident.
'Specified causes of loss' means fire, lightning, explosion, windstorm, hail, smoke, aircraft, vehicles, riot, vandalism, and leakage from fire extinguishing equipment.
'Your product' means goods or products manufactured, sold, handled, distributed, or disposed of by you.
'Inpatient' means a person admitted to a hospital as a registered bed patient for at least 24 hours.
'Bodily injury' means bodily harm, sickness, or disease, including death resulting from any of these.
What's an 'occurrence'? It's an accident, including continuous or repeated exposure to the same harmful conditions.
'Terminal illness' means a condition diagnosed by a physician that is expected to result in death within 12 months.
